question: What was days sales outstanding for invoices paid in Q1 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT avg(p.paid_date - i.issued_date) FROM analytics.payments p JOIN analytics.invoices i ON i.id = p.invoice_id WHERE p.paid_date >= '2026-01-01' AND p.paid_date < '2026-04-01'

question: What is the total value of invoices issued in 2026 that have not been paid?
